name: What's the difference between custom, semi-custom, and stock cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between custom, semi-custom, and stock cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, offering unlimited design flexibility, materials, and finishes to perfectly fit your space and style. Semi-custom cabinets offer more options than stock cabinets in terms of sizes, finishes, and accessories, but within a predefined range. Stock cabinets are mass-produced in standard sizes and limited finishes, providing the most economical option. Your choice depends on your budget, design preferences, and the unique requirements of your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets are fully tailored, semi-custom offer more options within a range, and stock cabinets are standard sizes.
